problem:
If $P$ is a $4\times 3$ matrix and $Q$ is a $3\times 7$ matrix, then the dimensions of $PQ$ are{{field-1}}$\times $
{{field-2}}.
worked_solution:
There are $3$ columns in $P$ and $3$ rows in $Q.$ Since the number of columns in $P$ equals the number of rows in $Q,$ the matrices $P$ and $Q$ are conformable for multiplication, and $PQ$ is a $4\times 7$ matrix:

$$
{P}_{4\times \boxed{\text{3}}}{\times }_{✓}{Q}_{\boxed{\text{3}}\times 7}={PQ}_{4\times 7}
$$
